Frozen parameters prevent all outputs

questions.quote: 推理是使用已训练的模型处理新输入。训练改变参数；推理通常使用已有参数产生预测或生成内容。

rationale.zh: 同样的数值误差可带来不同损失，应把预测误差连接实际业务后果。
rationale.en: Similar numerical errors can have different consequences; connect error to business impact.

misconception.zh: 常见误判：误差相近就无需看后果
misconception.en: Common error: Ignore consequences because errors are similar

prompt.zh: 本演练：两版预测误差相近，但高估会积压、低估会缺货。选择评审做法。
prompt.en: In this exercise: Two versions have similar errors, but overestimates cause excess inventory and underestimates cause shortages. Choose an evaluation approach.

reason.zh: 同样的数值误差可带来不同损失，应把预测误差连接实际业务后果。 回看“预测 Prediction”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Similar numerical errors can have different consequences; connect error to business impact. Revisit Prediction and check the evidence.

text.zh: 同时比较误差方向和业务后果
text.en: Compare error direction and business consequences

text.zh: 误差相近就无需看后果
text.en: Ignore consequences because errors are similar

text.zh: 预测数值等于确定未来
text.en: Treat the forecast as certain future truth

questions.q: 本演练：库存经理只提交平均预测误差，没有说明高估与低估的后果。评审应补什么？
questions.a: 分别分析积压与缺货等错误后果
wrong: 误差是数值所以无需业务解释
所有预测都应被当成确定承诺

en.q: In this exercise: An inventory manager reports average forecast error without over/underestimate consequences. What should review add?
en.a: Analyze consequences such as excess stock and shortages separately
wrong: Numeric error needs no business interpretation
All predictions should be certain commitments

questions.quote: 预测是利用输入和已学习的模式估计未知结果。业务评价既要看误差，也要看错误会造成的后果。

rationale.zh: 明确目标标签是本任务关键，不能按数据规模猜学习方式。
rationale.en: Target labels are decisive here; dataset size does not determine the learning approach.

misconception.zh: 常见误判：有标签所以只能做无监督聚类
misconception.en: Common error: Labels mean only unsupervised clustering is possible

prompt.zh: 本演练：现有交易样本都标注了是否欺诈，团队要学习输入到欺诈标签的映射。选择合适依据。
prompt.en: In this exercise: Transactions are labeled fraud or legitimate and the team learns the input-to-label mapping. Which basis fits?

reason.zh: 明确目标标签是本任务关键，不能按数据规模猜学习方式。 回看“监督学习”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Target labels are decisive here; dataset size does not determine the learning approach. Revisit Supervised learning and check the evidence.

text.zh: 有标签所以只能做无监督聚类
text.en: Labels mean only unsupervised clustering is possible

text.zh: 带目标标签，可评估监督学习
text.en: Target labels support evaluating supervised learning

text.zh: 必须靠环境奖励才能使用这些标签
text.en: Environment rewards are required to use these labels

questions.q: 本演练：房价样本包含房屋特征和已成交价格，学习目标是估计新房价格。哪项理由支持监督学习？
questions.a: 已有目标价格标签，学习输入到目标映射
wrong: 价格是数值所以不能监督学习
存在特征就一定没有目标标签

en.q: In this exercise: House records have features and sale prices, and the goal is new-price estimates. What supports supervised learning?
en.a: Target price labels enable learning an input-target mapping
wrong: Numeric targets prevent supervised learning
Features imply there are no target labels

questions.quote: 使用带有目标标签的样本学习输入到目标的映射，可用于分类和回归。

rationale.zh: 无标签可以探索结构，但找到分群不等于自动证明业务含义。
rationale.en: Unlabeled data supports structure exploration; clusters do not automatically establish business meaning.

misconception.zh: 常见误判：先把不存在的类别答案当真值
misconception.en: Common error: Treat nonexistent category answers as ground truth

title.zh: 无监督学习应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。

prompt.en: In this exercise: There are no predefined customer labels; the team wants groups by purchasing patterns. What fits?

reason.zh: 无标签可以探索结构，但找到分群不等于自动证明业务含义。 回看“无监督学习”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Unlabeled data supports structure exploration; clusters do not automatically establish business meaning. Revisit Unsupervised learning and check the evidence.

text.zh: 先把不存在的类别答案当真值
text.en: Treat nonexistent category answers as ground truth

text.zh: 评估无监督聚类，并解释找到的结构
text.en: Evaluate unsupervised clustering and interpret the structure

text.zh: 把每个分群当成已验证业务结论
text.en: Treat every cluster as a verified business conclusion

questions.q: 本演练：分析师声称无标签分群已经验证了“高价值客户”真值。评审应指出什么？
questions.a: 分群发现结构，不等于拥有目标真值
wrong: 无标签数据不能包含任何结构
每个聚类名称自动成为真实标签

en.q: In this exercise: An analyst claims unlabeled clusters verify high-value-customer ground truth. What should review note?
en.a: Clustering finds structure; it does not supply target ground truth
wrong: Unlabeled data cannot contain structure
Every cluster name automatically becomes a true label

questions.quote: 从没有目标标签的数据中寻找结构或模式，例如将相似对象聚类。

rationale.zh: 强化学习的交互和累计回报要同时出现，不能只记住奖励这个词。
rationale.en: Interaction and cumulative return both matter; recognizing the word reward is insufficient.

misconception.zh: 常见误判：把奖励当作固定目标类别标签
misconception.en: Common error: Treat rewards as fixed category labels

prompt.en: In this exercise: A replenishment agent acts in simulation and receives rewards. Rewarding only today ignores longer outcomes. Which definition fits?

reason.zh: 强化学习的交互和累计回报要同时出现，不能只记住奖励这个词。 回看“强化学习”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Interaction and cumulative return both matter; recognizing the word reward is insufficient. Revisit Reinforcement learning and check the evidence.

text.zh: 把奖励当作固定目标类别标签
text.en: Treat rewards as fixed category labels

text.zh: 用交互反馈学习策略并关注长期累计回报
text.en: Learn a policy from interaction feedback with cumulative return

text.zh: 完全不考虑后续结果
text.en: Ignore subsequent outcomes

questions.q: 本演练：两个策略当天奖励相同，但后续库存表现不同。按强化学习目标应关注什么？
questions.a: 长期累计回报，而非只看当天
wrong: 永远只比较第一步奖励
忽略环境交互，只统计标签数量

en.q: In this exercise: Two policies earn equal rewards today but differ in later inventory outcomes. What should the RL objective consider?
en.a: Cumulative return rather than today alone
wrong: Always compare only the first reward
Ignore interactions and only count labels

questions.quote: 智能体通过与环境交互和奖励反馈学习行动策略，关注长期累计回报。

rationale.zh: 结构与准确性是两个维度；统一字段不能修正录入错误。
rationale.en: Structure and accuracy are separate; consistent fields do not correct entry errors.

misconception.zh: 常见误判：字段固定就保证内容正确
misconception.en: Common error: Fixed fields guarantee accurate values

title.zh: 结构化数据应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练：把每项观察或任务放入对应类别。
prompt.en: In this exercise: put each observation or task in its matching category.

reason.zh: 结构与准确性是两个维度；统一字段不能修正录入错误。 回看“结构化数据”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Structure and accuracy are separate; consistent fields do not correct entry errors. Revisit Structured data and check the evidence.

text.zh: 结构说明
text.en: Structure statement

text.zh: 还需核验的内容
text.en: Values needing checks

text.zh: 表含固定日期与数量字段
text.en: Table has fixed date and quantity fields

text.zh: 订单数量是否录入准确
text.en: Whether order quantities were entered accurately

questions.q: 本演练：数据团队把订单正文整理为固定字段，但发现商品编号录错。哪条验收判断正确？
questions.a: 结构化完成不等于内容准确，仍需修正编号
wrong: 有统一字段就必须判定数据准确
录错一个值就证明根本没有字段结构

en.q: In this exercise: Order prose is converted to fixed fields, but product IDs are incorrect. Which acceptance judgment is correct?
en.a: Structuring is not accuracy; IDs still need correction
wrong: Uniform fields require passing accuracy
One incorrect value proves there is no field structure

questions.quote: 结构化数据有相对明确的字段或模式，便于按统一口径查询、统计和校验。结构清晰不等于内容必然准确。

rationale.zh: 非结构化不是无信息，需要与任务相关的提取与组织。
rationale.en: Unstructured does not mean uninformative; task-specific extraction and organization are needed.

misconception.zh: 常见误判：假设录音已有固定关系表字段
misconception.en: Common error: Assume audio already has fixed table fields

title.zh: 非结构化数据应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.en: In this exercise: Requests are in audio and prose and cannot be aggregated as fixed fields. What comes next?

reason.zh: 非结构化不是无信息，需要与任务相关的提取与组织。 回看“非结构化数据”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Unstructured does not mean uninformative; task-specific extraction and organization are needed. Revisit Unstructured data and check the evidence.

text.zh: 非结构化资料永远不能使用
text.en: Unstructured material can never be used

text.zh: 先提取并组织相关信息，再统一汇总
text.en: Extract and organize relevant information before aggregation

text.zh: 假设录音已有固定关系表字段
text.en: Assume audio already has fixed table fields

questions.q: 本演练：扫描图片与录音里有客户信息，业务方认为没有表格就没有可用信息。如何回应？
questions.a: 先提取与用途有关的信息，再组织使用
wrong: 非结构化就等于信息为空
直接假设所有录音都有固定日期字段

en.q: In this exercise: Scans and audio contain customer information, but the business says no table means no usable information. How should you respond?
en.a: Extract task-relevant information and organize it
wrong: Unstructured means empty information
Assume all recordings have fixed date fields

questions.quote: 非结构化数据通常不像关系表那样具有固定字段结构，常见形式有正文、图片和录音。使用前可能需要提取与组织信息。

rationale.zh: 不同缺陷对应不同质量维度；模型规模不能自动补救原料。
rationale.en: Different defects affect different quality dimensions; model size cannot automatically repair inputs.

misconception.zh: 常见误判：只换更大模型，跳过数据检查
misconception.en: Common error: Use a bigger model and skip data checks

title.zh: 数据质量应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.en: In this exercise: Refund analysis finds stale dates, missing amounts and conflicting definitions. Choose a first response.

reason.zh: 不同缺陷对应不同质量维度；模型规模不能自动补救原料。 回看“数据质量”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Different defects affect different quality dimensions; model size cannot automatically repair inputs. Revisit Data quality and check the evidence.

text.zh: 只换更大模型，跳过数据检查
text.en: Use a bigger model and skip data checks

text.zh: 按用途检查时效、完整与一致性并修复数据
text.en: Check freshness, completeness and consistency for the use and repair data

text.zh: 数据量增加即可保证所有维度
text.en: More data guarantees every quality dimension

questions.q: 本演练：销量记录齐全且格式一致，但都来自过期产品。能仅凭完整性通过当前需求分析验收吗？
questions.a: 不能，还需检查时效性和与用途的相关性
wrong: 能，完整性代替所有质量维度
能，只要换一个大模型

en.q: In this exercise: Sales records are complete and consistent but concern obsolete products. Is completeness sufficient for current demand analysis?
en.a: No; freshness and relevance to the use also matter
wrong: Yes; completeness replaces every quality dimension
Yes, provided a larger model is used

questions.quote: 数据质量要结合用途检查准确性、完整性、一致性、时效性及相关性。更大的模型无法自动补救所有数据缺陷。

rationale.zh: 历史条件并不固定延续，独立样本和环境比较共同支持泛化判断。
rationale.en: Historical conditions may not persist; independent examples and environment comparison support generalization assessment.

misconception.zh: 常见误判：只重复历史训练分数
misconception.en: Common error: Only repeat the historical training score

title.zh: 历史数据与泛化应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。

prompt.en: In this exercise: Past customers were mostly offline and the new business is online. How should the historical model be tested?

reason.zh: 历史条件并不固定延续，独立样本和环境比较共同支持泛化判断。 回看“历史数据与泛化”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Historical conditions may not persist; independent examples and environment comparison support generalization assessment. Revisit Generalization and historical data and check the evidence.

text.zh: 过去有效就永久有效
text.en: Past success guarantees permanent success

text.zh: 只重复历史训练分数
text.en: Only repeat the historical training score

text.zh: 用独立的新环境样本评估，并调查环境差异
text.en: Evaluate independent new-environment examples and investigate differences

questions.q: 本演练：验证样本虽然独立，却完全来自旧业务环境。新环境可靠性的结论应如何表述？
questions.a: 仍需检验新环境差异，不能直接保证可靠
wrong: 只要独立就保证未来所有环境
历史数据永远无法用于任何模型

en.q: In this exercise: Evaluation examples are independent but entirely from the old business environment. How should new-environment reliability be stated?
en.a: New-environment differences still need assessment; reliability is not guaranteed
wrong: Independence guarantees every future environment
Historical data can never be useful

questions.quote: 历史数据反映过去的条件。要用独立数据检验模型能否处理未见情况，并留意未来环境与历史数据是否不同。

rationale.zh: 答案泄漏使评估过于乐观，独立性比漂亮分数更关键。

misconception.zh: 常见误判：把测试高分直接当上线证据
misconception.en: Common error: Treat the leaked test score as launch evidence

prompt.en: In this exercise: A colleague adds test answers to training and obtains a high score. How can unseen-data evaluation be preserved?

reason.zh: 答案泄漏使评估过于乐观，独立性比漂亮分数更关键。 回看“训练集与验证”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Answer leakage inflates evaluation; independence matters more than a polished score. Revisit Training, validation and test sets and check the evidence.

questions.a: 使用未参与模型调整的新独立测试数据
wrong: 继续在同一测试答案上反复优化
删除低分记录保留高分

en.q: In this exercise: Developers inspect test answers and change the model, raising its score. What can restore independent evidence?
en.a: Use fresh independent test data not used in model adjustment
wrong: Keep optimizing on the same test answers
Delete low scores and keep high ones

questions.quote: 训练数据用于学习，独立验证或测试用于检验未见样本的表现。把测试答案带入训练会让结果显得过于乐观。

questions.a: 共同定义术语及各阶段含义，再讨论方案
wrong: 用框架名称替代阶段定义
因使用框架而免除准确性检验

en.q: In this exercise: Business and engineering treat model deployment and training completion as one milestone. What should be agreed first?

wrong: Replace stage definitions with a framework name

wrong: Good text proves all actions are safe

questions.quote: 代理围绕目标协调步骤和工具，可能具有一定自主性。代理的行动权限、失败处理和监督方式需要单独设计。

只比较代理名称是否足够专业

en.q: In this exercise: Adding a review agent causes reports to lose source evidence. Which part should be checked most directly?
en.a: Information exchange and handoff quality
wrong: Keep adding agents until it disappears
Only compare how professional agent names sound

questions.quote: 多个代理的角色分工、信息交换和执行顺序属于编排问题。角色越多不自动代表效果越好，要检查任务完成与交接质量。

en.a: No; keep observing quality, costs and feedback and investigate changes
wrong: Yes; one acceptance guarantees permanent performance

questions.quote: 输入分布或业务关系变化可能使模型表现变差。部署后持续观察质量、成本和反馈，发现变化后调查原因并纠正。

wrong: Tool icon colors
Assume every tool may process sensitive data

questions.quote: 明确哪些工具已批准、受限、被阻止或仍在评估，说明数据使用边界并提供合适替代方案，有助于减少未经批准的使用。

prompt.zh: 本演练：同版规则规定金额大于100需复核，否则通过。修复状态：输入 pass（通过）或 review（复核），使用这两个固定代码。
prompt.en: In this exercise: the same rule version requires review above 100, otherwise pass. Repair statuses using the fixed codes pass or review.

reason.zh: 固定输入与规则版本要求结果可重复；金额仅是演练政策。 回看“确定性与可重复执行”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Fixed input and rule version require repeatability; the amount is an exercise policy only. Revisit Deterministic execution and check the evidence.

questions.q: 本演练：相同申请在相同规则版本下两次得出不同结果，且输入完全一致。该现象最直接违反什么？
questions.a: 同输入同版本应得到同结果的可重复性
wrong: 必须使用生成模型的要求
规则系统不能使用阈值的要求

en.q: In this exercise: Identical applications and rule version produce different results with identical inputs. What is directly violated?
en.a: Repeatability: same input and rule version should yield the same result
wrong: A requirement to use a generative model
A rule that deterministic systems cannot use thresholds

rationale.zh: 输出估计、生成内容、外部行动各有不同失败方式，需分别验收。

misconception.zh: 常见误判：文字流畅就证明下单权限正确

reason.zh: 异常停止条件优先于一般重试额度，自主性不代表无限权限。 回看“自主性与停止条件”，按证据重新判断。

用更多目标文字替代执行边界

prompt.zh: 本演练：故障接手必须由可全天值班的团队负责。销售组(sales)仅工作日白天值班，运营组(ops)全天值班。恢复路径必须已通过恢复演练：旧系统(legacy)已通过，新平台(new)尚未演练。政策规定失败请求比例超过2%即回退；本次共1000请求，30次失败。错误交接单写着负责人sales、触发阈值5%、恢复路径new。根据职责、政策和验证记录修复交接单；团队与路径填括号内英文编码，阈值填百分数。
prompt.en: Exercise: incident ownership requires around-the-clock coverage. Sales (sales) covers weekday daytime only; Operations (ops) covers all hours. Recovery must use a route that passed a restoration drill: the old system (legacy) passed, while the new platform (new) is untested. Policy requires rollback when failed requests exceed 2%; this run had 30 failures out of 1,000 requests. The faulty handover lists owner sales, threshold 5%, route new. Repair it using duties, policy and validation evidence. Enter the team and route codes in parentheses and a numeric percentage for the threshold.

reason.zh: 只有ops满足全天故障接手职责，只有legacy通过恢复演练；阈值按预先政策修正为2，而不是把本次实际失败率3%写成阈值。本次3%超过2%，应由ops启动已验证的legacy路径。回看「切换、回退与业务连续性」。
reason.en: Only ops meets the coverage requirement, and only legacy passed the recovery drill. The policy threshold is 2, distinct from this run’s actual 3% failure rate. Because 3% exceeds 2%, ops should initiate the verified legacy route. Revisit “Cutover, rollback and continuity”.

misconception.zh: 省时即减薪支出。

reason.zh: 时间释放尚未减少支出；取消支出才有已实现现金节省证据。 回看「释放产能与现金节省」。
reason.en: Freed time has not reduced spending; canceled expense provides realized cash evidence. Revisit “Released capacity and cash savings”.

text.zh: 释放产能
text.en: Released capacity

text.zh: 现金节省

text.zh: 已取消的外包支出
text.en: Eliminated outsourcing spend

questions.q: 省时后工资不变，最稳妥的直接报告是什么？
questions.a: 释放产能，现金收益需另证
wrong: 已经减少工资支出
同批工时同时算减员和新增收入

en.q: Time is saved but payroll unchanged. What is directly supported?
en.a: Released capacity; cash benefits need further evidence
wrong: Payroll spending has fallen
Count the same hours as both headcount cuts and new revenue

questions.quote: 节省工时可释放产能，但只有支出实际减少才构成现金成本节省。若把产能用于新增产出，还需证明需求、人员安排和新增收入能够实现。

rationale.zh: 将信号连接到后续验证。
rationale.en: Connect a signal to later validation.

misconception.zh: 培训出勤等于独立胜任。
misconception.en: Equating attendance with independent competence.

prompt.zh: 本演练要求先记录培训，再测独立核验正确率，最后检查服务质量。按该验证依赖排序。
prompt.en: Exercise: record training first, test independent verification accuracy next, then inspect service quality. Order these dependencies.

reason.zh: 先导活动需通过能力与业务结果检验联系；出勤不能代替后两项。 回看「先导信号与滞后结果」。
reason.en: Leading activity needs capability and outcome checks; attendance cannot replace them. Revisit “Leading and lagging indicators”.

text.zh: 测独立核验正确率
text.en: Measure independent verification accuracy

text.zh: 检查后续服务质量
text.en: Inspect later service quality

text.zh: 记录培训完成
text.en: Record training completion

questions.q: 培训完成率100%，下一步应怎样评估？
questions.a: 追踪能力表现与后续质量结果
wrong: 立即认定净收益为正
停止所有后续观察

en.q: Training completion is 100%. What should evaluation do next?
en.a: Track capability performance and later quality outcomes
wrong: Immediately declare positive net benefit
Stop all further observation

questions.quote: 培训完成、使用频率等可作为早期信号；留存、服务质量、净收益等结果需要后续观察。应说明预期联系，并检验先导指标能否预测结果。

rationale.zh: 汇总生命周期成本而非只算模型。
rationale.en: Sum lifecycle costs instead of model fees alone.

misconception.zh: 退出迁移不进预算。
misconception.en: Excluding exit costs.

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练年度预算：数据整理10、集成20、调用30、培训5、复核15、监测维护10、退出准备10（万元）。求总成本。
prompt.en: Exercise annual budget: data 10, integration 20, calls 30, training 5, review 15, monitoring/maintenance 10, exit preparation 10. Sum costs in the same unit.

reason.zh: 各项合计100；只报调用30会漏掉数据、人工与生命周期支出。 回看「全生命周期成本」。
reason.en: The sum is 100; reporting calls alone omits data, human and lifecycle expenses. Revisit “Lifecycle cost”.

questions.q: 调用量翻倍时应重看什么？
questions.a: 单位成本、总成本与复核等配套成本
wrong: 只看原月套餐价格
认为总成本不会变化

en.q: What should be revisited when call volume doubles?
en.a: Unit cost, total cost and related review costs
wrong: Only the original monthly plan price
Assume total costs never change

questions.quote: 预算包括数据整理、集成、部署、调用或计算、培训、人工复核、监测、维护和退出迁移。按业务量变化分析单位成本和总成本。

rationale.zh: 竞争判断回到客户需求。
rationale.en: Return competitive analysis to customer needs.

misconception.zh: 复制同行工具等于战略。
misconception.en: Mistaking tool imitation for strategy.

prompt.zh: 本演练：同行上线聊天机器人，本企业投诉集中在退款等待。选择先调查的内容。
prompt.en: Exercise: a competitor launches a chatbot; your complaints concern refund delays. Choose the first investigation.

reason.zh: 投资需要连接客户问题与自身条件；复制工具无法证明能解决退款障碍。 回看「竞争格局」。
reason.en: Investment needs a link to customer problems and local conditions; imitation does not establish a refund solution. Revisit “Competitive landscape”.

text.zh: 直接复制同行采购清单
text.en: Copy the competitor purchasing list

text.zh: 同行界面的配色
text.en: Competitor interface colors

text.zh: 退款流程障碍、客户期待与自身可改善环节
text.en: Refund workflow barriers, customer expectations and improvable steps

questions.q: 竞争者购买同一模型，是否意味着双方获得同等业务价值？
questions.a: 不一定，需求、流程和自身条件不同
wrong: 一定，模型相同价值相同
一定，价格决定全部价值

en.q: If competitors buy the same model, do they gain equal business value?
en.a: Not necessarily; needs, workflows and conditions differ
wrong: Yes; identical models give identical value
Yes; price determines all value

questions.quote: 比较客户需求、竞争者能力和自己的独特条件，找到AI可改善的业务环节，而不是仅追随流行工具。

rationale.zh: 检查转型是否带来运营要求。
rationale.en: Test whether transformation includes operating requirements.

misconception.zh: 加聊天窗口就完成转型。
misconception.en: Calling a chat window a transformed business model.

title.zh: 业务模式转型：决策演练

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：一次性报告转为持续决策服务。选择必须重新评估的全部事项。
prompt.en: Exercise: one-off reports become continuous decision support. Select all items requiring reassessment.

reason.zh: 持续服务改变交付与维护要求；标签不能替代客户价值和运营方案。 回看「业务模式转型」。
reason.en: Continuous service changes delivery and maintenance; labels cannot replace value and operations. Revisit “Business model transformation”.

text.zh: 持续客户价值与服务交付流程
text.en: Ongoing customer value and service delivery

text.zh: 只修改产品标签
text.en: Change only the product label

text.zh: 数据维护和运营责任
text.en: Data maintenance and operational ownership

questions.q: 原产品仅改名“AI版”，能据此认定业务模式已转型吗？
questions.a: 不能，还需检查价值、交付或价值获取变化
wrong: 能，名称足以证明
能，界面有AI字样即可

en.q: A product is renamed “AI edition.” Does this establish business-model transformation?
en.a: No; examine value, delivery or value-capture changes
wrong: Yes; naming proves it
Yes; an AI label suffices

questions.quote: AI可能改变产品、服务、交付或价值获取方式。评估客户价值与运营要求，而不是只给原流程加一个聊天窗口。

rationale.zh: 筛选构成持续能力的投入。
rationale.en: Select investments in sustained capabilities.

misconception.zh: 安装量就是长期优势。
misconception.en: Treating installation count as durable advantage.

title.zh: 可持续优势：决策演练

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：选择支持持续优势的全部行动。
prompt.en: Exercise: select all actions supporting sustainable advantage.

reason.zh: 反馈、流程和能力互补才形成可持续积累；安装量不证明业务能力。 回看「可持续优势」。
reason.en: Feedback, workflows and capabilities complement one another; installations do not establish business capability. Revisit “Sustainable advantage”.

text.zh: 核验反馈并持续改进流程
text.en: Verify feedback and improve workflows continuously

text.zh: 只统计安装数量并停止学习
text.en: Count installations and stop learning

text.zh: 培养领域人员并将数据用于获授权流程
text.en: Develop domain staff and apply data in authorized workflows

questions.q: 上线通用模型后下一步更能支持持续优势的是？
questions.a: 建立经核验反馈和流程改进闭环
wrong: 停止评估，因为工具已买
只提高安装数

en.q: After deploying a common model, what better supports durable advantage?
en.a: Build verified feedback and workflow-improvement loops
wrong: Stop evaluating because the tool is purchased
Increase installation count only

questions.quote: 可持续优势往往来自相关数据、流程、组织能力和反馈的组合。单一工具上线不保证长期优势。

rationale.zh: 将准备度映射到分阶段投资。
rationale.en: Map readiness to staged investment.

misconception.zh: 竞争压力要求无条件扩张。
misconception.en: Treating competition as a reason for unconditional expansion.

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：数据基础不稳，董事会规定先完成治理验证再扩展。安排这三个承诺。
prompt.en: Exercise: data foundations are weak; the board requires governance validation before expansion. Order these commitments.

reason.zh: 先补准备再验证再决策，与组织能力和风险承受相匹配；竞争压力不能补齐数据。 回看「投资与成熟度」。
reason.en: Readiness, evidence and staged decisions match capability and risk tolerance; competitive pressure cannot repair data. Revisit “Investment and maturity”.

text.zh: 小范围试点检验价值与风险
text.en: Pilot to test value and risk

text.zh: 依据达标证据决定是否扩展
text.en: Decide whether to scale based on gate evidence

text.zh: 投入数据治理并验证准备
text.en: Fund data governance and validate readiness

questions.q: 数据基础尚不稳，应如何安排投入？
questions.a: 先治理并小范围验证，再按证据决定扩展
wrong: 立即全企业替换
只参考同行花费

en.q: Data foundations are weak. How should investment proceed?
en.a: Improve governance and pilot, then scale based on evidence
wrong: Replace systems enterprise-wide immediately
Use competitor spending alone

questions.quote: 投资规模应结合行业变化、竞争压力、组织准备度及风险承受能力。需要验证条件与分阶段投入。

rationale.zh: 比较客户证据而非预算竞赛。
rationale.en: Compare customer evidence rather than budgets.

misconception.zh: 同行预算决定本企业投入。
misconception.en: Using competitor budgets as your business case.

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。

prompt.zh: 本演练：同行投入千万，本企业尚未定位客户障碍。选择有证据意识的动作。
prompt.en: Exercise: a competitor spends ten million; your customer barriers are unknown. Choose an evidence-oriented action.

reason.zh: 竞争变化是调查线索，不是本企业的收益证明；需要自身业务证据。 回看「客户问题与竞争位置」。
reason.en: Competitive change prompts investigation; it does not prove your returns. Local evidence is needed. Revisit “Customer need and competitive position”.

text.zh: 无条件投入更大金额
text.en: Spend more unconditionally

text.zh: 调查客户期待、交付障碍与价值链影响
text.en: Investigate customer expectations, delivery barriers and value-chain effects

text.zh: 假定相同工具产生相同价值
text.en: Assume the same tool gives equal value

questions.q: 同行聊天机器人受欢迎，是否直接证明本企业也应复制？
questions.a: 否，先核对本企业客户需求与流程条件
wrong: 是，受欢迎即可迁移
是，只要花同样金额

en.q: A competitor’s chatbot is popular. Does this prove you should copy it?
en.a: No; check your customers’ needs and workflow conditions
wrong: Yes; popularity transfers automatically
Yes; match the spending

questions.quote: 分析竞争变化如何影响客户期待、交付效率和价值链，再决定投资方向。相同工具在不同业务条件下可能产生不同价值。

rationale.zh: 用结构分类检查业务模式完整性。
rationale.en: Classify a model’s components to inspect completeness.

misconception.zh: 技术标签代替收益逻辑。
misconception.en: Replacing revenue logic with a technology label.

title.en: Value proposition, delivery and revenue: decision lab

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练持续监测服务：将方案条目归入价值、交付、收益。
prompt.en: Exercise continuous monitoring service: classify each proposal component as value, delivery or revenue.

reason.zh: 提醒说明客户所得，维护响应说明如何交付，收费说明价值获取；三者不能用标签代替。 回看「价值主张、交付与收益逻辑」。
reason.en: Alerts define value, maintenance defines delivery and charging defines capture; a label replaces none of them. Revisit “Value proposition, delivery and revenue”.

text.zh: 客户价值
text.en: Customer value

text.zh: 交付方式
text.en: Delivery

text.zh: 收益逻辑
text.en: Revenue

text.zh: 及时获得异常提醒
text.en: Timely exception alerts

text.zh: 团队持续维护与响应
text.en: Team maintains service and responds continuously

text.zh: 按约定服务期收费
text.en: Charge for an agreed service period

questions.q: 从项目咨询改持续监测，需要重看什么？
questions.a: 客户价值、持续运营责任与定价收益方式
wrong: 仅把名称改成AI
只更换图标

en.q: Moving from project consulting to continuous monitoring requires what review?
en.a: Customer value, ongoing responsibility and pricing/revenue
wrong: Only rename it AI
Only change the icon

questions.quote: 业务模式变化涉及提供何种客户价值、如何交付以及如何获得收益。给现有产品贴AI标签不等于重构业务模式。

rationale.zh: 辨别互补能力与数据权利。
rationale.en: Distinguish complementary capabilities and data rights.

misconception.zh: 数据量大等于有权使用。
misconception.en: Equating data volume with permission.

title.zh: 互补能力与学习闭环：决策演练
title.en: Complementary capabilities and learning: decision lab

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：选择可用于持续服务改进的全部要素；题设仅a/b已获授权。
prompt.en: Exercise: select all usable elements for continuing service improvement; only a/b have authorization.

reason.zh: 授权数据与领域流程互补；数量不能补上未知来源或使用权。 回看「互补能力与学习闭环」。
reason.en: Authorized data complements domain workflows; volume cannot supply provenance or permission. Revisit “Complementary capabilities and learning”.

text.zh: 获授权且核验的维修反馈
text.en: Authorized, verified maintenance feedback

text.zh: 来源不明的大量客户记录
text.en: Large customer records with unknown provenance

text.zh: 领域团队将反馈嵌入改进流程
text.en: Domain team embeds feedback into improvements

questions.q: 拥有大量记录是否足以证明持续优势？
questions.a: 否，还需授权、可用性和流程能力等条件
wrong: 是，数量自动产生独占权
是，无需核验数据

en.q: Do large data holdings alone establish durable advantage?
en.a: No; permission, usability and workflow capability also matter
wrong: Yes; volume automatically grants exclusivity
Yes; no verification needed

questions.quote: 可持续优势常来自获授权的数据、嵌入流程、领域经验、客户关系和持续反馈的组合，而不是人人都能购买的同一基础模型。

rationale.zh: 将停止门槛落实到扩展决定。
rationale.en: Apply stop gates to a scaling decision.

misconception.zh: 已花费就必须继续。
misconception.en: Treating sunk cost as a reason to continue.

title.zh: 分阶段承诺与停止条件：决策演练

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练预设扩展需质量≥95、月成本≤10万元、风险审查通过。现质量96、成本12、审查通过。选择下一步。
prompt.en: Exercise scaling gates: quality ≥95, monthly cost ≤10, risk review passed. Actual quality 96, cost 12, review passed. Choose.

reason.zh: 成本门槛未达标；其他达标和沉没投入不能替代预先约定的停止条件。 回看「分阶段承诺与停止条件」。
reason.en: The cost gate failed; passing other gates and sunk spending do not replace the predeclared stop condition. Revisit “Staged commitments and stop conditions”.

text.zh: 暂停扩展，核验并改善成本后再评估
text.en: Pause scaling, verify and improve costs, then reassess

text.zh: 事后删除成本门槛
text.en: Delete the cost gate after the result

text.zh: 因试点已花钱立即扩展
text.en: Scale because the pilot already cost money

questions.q: 试点未达质量门槛但已投入很多，应怎么决策？
questions.a: 按预设条件暂停或退出并复核关键假设
wrong: 为追回投入无条件扩展
事后降低门槛宣布成功

en.q: A pilot fails its quality gate after substantial spending. What should happen?
en.a: Pause or exit under the predeclared conditions and review assumptions
wrong: Scale unconditionally to recover spending
Lower the gate after the result and declare success

questions.quote: 结合行业条件和自身准备度，先验证关键假设，再逐步扩大投入。预先定义价值、质量、风险和成本不达标时的暂停或退出条件。

rationale.zh: 把责任原则转成可检查的控制，检验能否从宣言迁移到行动。
rationale.en: Translate principles into observable controls to test transfer from slogans to action.

misconception.zh: 有原则海报就等于已治理。
misconception.en: A principles poster is treated as implemented governance.

title.zh: 负责任的AI原则：决策演练

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 团队只有一张责任原则海报。选择所有能产生实际评估或控制证据的补充工作。
prompt.en: The team has only a principles poster. Select every addition that produces actual assessment or control evidence.

reason.zh: 分组差错评估和异常条件测试让原则进入实际验证；仅改宣传措辞不能证明控制有效。 常见错误：有原则海报就等于已治理。 回看《负责任的AI原则》。
reason.en: Subgroup error assessment and abnormal-condition tests operationalize principles; promotional wording does not demonstrate effective controls. Common error: A principles poster is treated as implemented governance. Review “Responsible AI principles”.

text.zh: 记录相关群体的差错并评审
text.en: Record and review errors for relevant groups

text.zh: 在异常输入下测试并记录结果
text.en: Test abnormal inputs and record results

text.zh: 把海报换成更醒目的颜色
text.en: Change the poster to brighter colors

questions.q: 团队声称遵循稳健性原则，哪项证据最直接支持此声明？
questions.a: 异常条件测试记录
wrong: 更大的海报
模型回答很自信

en.q: What most directly supports a team’s robustness claim?
en.a: Recorded abnormal-condition tests
wrong: A larger poster
Confident model wording

questions.quote: 公平性、可说明性、隐私、安全、透明度和稳健性需要进入实际决策与控制，而不仅是口号。不同任务需要相应评估。

rationale.zh: 在硬约束下配置资源，体验收益不能自动压倒责任要求。
rationale.en: Allocate resources under explicit constraints to experience why benefits do not override responsibility requirements.

misconception.zh: 以最高效率替代对影响和责任的说明。
misconception.en: Maximum efficiency replaces explanation of impact and ownership.

title.zh: 目标冲突与取舍：决策演练
title.en: Competing objectives and trade-offs: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练给定：预算3；必须做影响记录和责任确认；总控制值至少3。选择满足全部约束的工作包。分值只用于本题。
prompt.en: Exercise: budget 3; impact recording and owner confirmation are mandatory; total control value must reach 3. Select a feasible package. Scores apply only here.

reason.zh: 影响记录和责任确认各占1预算，风险控制占1，恰好达到3；纯加速项不满足责任硬约束。取舍需记录理由。 常见错误：以最高效率替代对影响和责任的说明。 回看《目标冲突与取舍》。
reason.en: Impact recording, owner confirmation and risk control each cost 1 and jointly reach 3. Acceleration alone misses mandatory responsibility constraints. Record the trade-off rationale. Common error: Maximum efficiency replaces explanation of impact and ownership. Review “Competing objectives and trade-offs”.

text.zh: 记录影响：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Record impact: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 确认决策责任：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Confirm decision owner: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 风险相称控制：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Proportionate control: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 仅提速：成本3，控制值0
text.en: Acceleration only: cost 3, control value 0

questions.q: 在效率与责任冲突的评审中，哪份记录更完整？
questions.a: 影响、约束、责任人及取舍理由
wrong: 仅记录节省的时间
只说所有人已同意

en.q: Which trade-off review record is more complete?
en.a: Impacts, constraints, decision owner and rationale
wrong: Only time saved
Only that everyone agreed

questions.quote: 效率、成本与责任要求可能冲突。把影响、约束和决策责任公开，选择与风险相称的措施并记录理由。

rationale.zh: 通过项目门序把治理放到设计前段。
rationale.en: Use project gates to place governance early in design.

misconception.zh: 上线后补监督与验证即可。
misconception.en: Oversight and validation can simply be added after launch.

title.zh: 从设计时纳入治理：决策演练

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练项目规定：先确定用途与责任，再设计验证和监督，通过验证后才上线。按这三道门排序。
prompt.en: Case policy: establish use and ownership, design evaluation and oversight, then deploy only after validation. Order these three gates.

reason.zh: 用途与责任约束验证和监督设计；通过这些验证才进入发布。把治理留到上线后会错过设计阶段的控制机会。 常见错误：上线后补监督与验证即可。 回看《从设计时纳入治理》。
reason.en: Use and ownership guide evaluation and oversight; deployment follows successful validation. Delaying governance misses design-stage controls. Common error: Oversight and validation can simply be added after launch. Review “Governance by design”.

text.zh: 设计监督并完成验证
text.en: Design oversight and complete validation

text.zh: 通过验证后上线
text.en: Deploy after validation passes

text.zh: 确定数据用途与责任
text.en: Define data use and ownership

questions.q: 项目还在功能设计阶段，何时确定数据用途和监督责任？
questions.a: 现在纳入设计并验证
wrong: 等上线发生事故后
等所有功能完成且不再变更时

en.q: When should a project in feature design define data use and oversight ownership?
en.a: Include them now in design and validation
wrong: After a production incident
After every feature is frozen

questions.quote: 在项目规划和设计阶段确定数据用途、责任、验证与监督，避免上线后才补救关键问题。

rationale.zh: 给定授权边界，让学习者操作停止与接手权限。
rationale.en: Operate stop and takeover permissions under explicit authority boundaries.

misconception.zh: 模型自信表达等于正式授权。
misconception.en: Confident model language counts as formal authorization.

title.zh: 人工监督与升级：决策演练
title.en: Human oversight and escalation: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练授权：监控员可暂停自动行动；审批员可决定恢复；模型无任何授权。勾选且仅勾选获授权的组合。
prompt.en: Exercise authority: monitor may pause automation; approver may authorize resumption; model has no authority. Select exactly the authorized combinations.

reason.zh: 停止与恢复是不同授权，按给定角色分配；模型无论措辞多自信都不能自行获得权限。 常见错误：模型自信表达等于正式授权。 回看《人工监督与升级》。
reason.en: Stopping and resumption are separate authorizations assigned by the case; confidence does not grant the model authority. Common error: Confident model language counts as formal authorization. Review “Human oversight and escalation”.

text.zh: 监控员
text.en: Monitor

text.zh: 审批员
text.en: Approver

text.zh: 模型
text.en: Model

text.zh: 暂停
text.en: Pause

text.zh: 批准恢复
text.en: Approve resumption

questions.q: 演练中模型说“我确信可以恢复”，但只有审批员有恢复权限。应该怎么做？
questions.a: 交审批员决定是否恢复
wrong: 接受模型自信声明并恢复
让模型自行签署授权

en.q: The model says it is certain resumption is safe, but only the approver may authorize it. What should happen?
en.a: Ask the approver to decide resumption
wrong: Resume based on confidence
Let the model grant itself authority

questions.quote: 明确何时人工检查、何时停止自动行动、何时上报，以及由谁接手。模型的自信措辞不能替代正式授权。

rationale.zh: 从总体指标中找出缺失的群体证据。
rationale.en: Detect missing group evidence behind an aggregate metric.

misconception.zh: 总体平均优秀足以证明公平。
misconception.en: A strong overall average proves fairness.

title.zh: 公平性与分组表现：决策演练
title.en: Fairness and subgroup outcomes: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练：总体错误率5%，但未按受影响群体统计。选择所有必要的下一步；本题不设普遍公平阈值。
prompt.en: Exercise: overall error rate is 5%, with no breakdown for affected groups. Select all necessary next steps; no universal fairness threshold is given.

reason.zh: 需要识别相关群体、比较差错和影响，并讨论取舍；一个总体均值不能给出群体分布。 常见错误：总体平均优秀足以证明公平。 回看《公平性与分组表现》。
reason.en: Identify relevant groups, compare errors and impacts, and discuss trade-offs; an aggregate average cannot reveal group distributions. Common error: A strong overall average proves fairness. Review “Fairness and subgroup outcomes”.

text.zh: 比较群体差错、机会和影响
text.en: Compare group errors, opportunities and impacts

text.zh: 直接宣布不存在公平性问题
text.en: Declare no fairness issue immediately

text.zh: 结合用途识别相关群体
text.en: Identify relevant groups for the use

questions.q: 两组错误差异很大，但总体指标达标。合理结论是什么？
questions.a: 仍需结合用途评估群体影响与取舍
wrong: 总体达标即证明公平
只看样本最多的一组

en.q: Group errors differ substantially while the overall target is met. What follows?
en.a: Assess group impacts and trade-offs for the use case
wrong: Overall success proves fairness
Examine only the largest group

questions.quote: 公平性评估要结合具体用途和受影响群体，检查差错、机会和影响的差异。总体平均指标不能替代相关群体评估，目标之间也可能存在取舍。

rationale.zh: 将用户可知情选择与理解判断依据区分开。
rationale.en: Distinguish informed choice from understanding a decision basis.

misconception.zh: 披露AI参与等同于解释每次判断。
misconception.en: Disclosing AI involvement explains each decision.

title.zh: 可说明性与透明度：决策演练

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 给交付物分类：解释判断依据放入可说明性；披露AI参与及边界放入透明度。
prompt.en: Classify deliverables: decision-basis explanations support explainability; disclosure of AI involvement and limits supports transparency.

reason.zh: 依据说明帮助理解行为；参与和限制披露帮助知情选择，两者不能互相替代。 常见错误：披露AI参与等同于解释每次判断。 回看《可说明性与透明度》。
reason.en: Explaining the basis supports understanding behavior; disclosing participation and limits supports informed choice. Neither substitutes for the other. Common error: Disclosing AI involvement explains each decision. Review “Explainability and transparency”.

text.zh: 可说明性
text.en: Explainability

text.zh: 透明度
text.en: Transparency

text.zh: 说明本次建议使用哪些判断依据
text.en: Explain the basis of this recommendation

text.zh: 告知用户AI参与及重要限制
text.en: Tell users about AI participation and key limits

questions.q: 页面只写“本服务使用AI”，还缺什么才能帮助理解一次建议？
questions.a: 解释该次建议的判断依据
wrong: 把AI提示字体放大
隐去适用边界

en.q: A page only says the service uses AI. What helps users understand a particular recommendation?
en.a: Explain the basis of that recommendation
wrong: Enlarge the AI notice
Hide the usage boundaries

questions.quote: 可说明性帮助理解系统行为或判断依据；透明度使相关人员了解AI参与、适用边界和重要限制，以便作出知情选择。

rationale.zh: 依据控制目的而不是技术名称定位责任缺口。
rationale.en: Locate control gaps by purpose rather than technology names.

misconception.zh: 有访问密码就解决所有隐私和稳健性问题。
misconception.en: A password resolves privacy and robustness too.

title.zh: 隐私、安全与稳健性：决策演练
title.en: Privacy, security and robustness: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 将三个独立检查路由到最直接的目的；这里按题面关注点分类。
prompt.en: Route three checks by their most direct purpose, using the stated focus.

reason.zh: 资料用途关注隐私，阻止未授权访问关注安全，变化条件下表现关注稳健性。控制可能互补，但目的有区别。 常见错误：有访问密码就解决所有隐私和稳健性问题。 回看《隐私、安全与稳健性》。
reason.en: Appropriate data use concerns privacy, unauthorized access concerns security, and behavior under change concerns robustness. Controls can complement one another but have distinct purposes. Common error: A password resolves privacy and robustness too. Review “Privacy, security and robustness”.

text.zh: 隐私
text.en: Privacy

text.zh: 安全
text.en: Security

text.zh: 稳健性
text.en: Robustness

text.zh: 检查个人资料是否用于适当目的
text.en: Check appropriate personal-data purposes

text.zh: 阻止无权限账号进入资料库
text.en: Block unauthorized accounts from the repository

text.zh: 测试输入异常时能否适当运行
text.en: Test appropriate behavior on unusual inputs

questions.q: 系统限制了账号访问，但从未测试环境变化。哪项仍缺证据？
questions.a: 稳健性
wrong: 已经证明全部责任原则
仅因有密码即可证明稳健

en.q: Accounts are access-controlled, but changing conditions were never tested. What still lacks evidence?
en.a: Robustness
wrong: Every responsibility principle is proven
A password already proves robustness

questions.quote: 隐私关注个人资料的适当使用与保护；安全关注防止未授权访问或破坏；稳健性关注系统在合理变化和异常条件下仍能适当运行。

rationale.zh: 补全评审记录中的影响维度，使比例判断可审计。
rationale.en: Complete impact dimensions so proportionality reasoning can be reviewed.

misconception.zh: 只记录收益，不记录损害严重性和可逆性。
misconception.en: Benefits are recorded while severity and reversibility are omitted.

title.zh: 收益、影响与比例原则：决策演练
title.en: Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 评审已记录节省时间。选择还应补充的全部信息，以讨论相称控制。
prompt.en: The review records time savings. Select every missing input needed to discuss proportionate controls.

reason.zh: 影响对象、可能性、严重程度、可逆性和决定责任共同支持取舍；厂商品牌不提供这些影响证据。 常见错误：只记录收益，不记录损害严重性和可逆性。 回看《收益、影响与比例原则》。
reason.en: Affected people, likelihood, severity, reversibility and decision ownership support the trade-off; a vendor brand provides none of this impact evidence. Common error: Benefits are recorded while severity and reversibility are omitted. Review “Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls”.

text.zh: 受影响对象及损害可能性
text.en: Affected people and likelihood of harm

text.zh: 严重程度与可逆性
text.en: Severity and reversibility

text.zh: 控制取舍和决定责任
text.en: Control trade-offs and decision ownership

text.zh: 只补模型品牌
text.en: Add only the model brand

questions.q: 两种用途收益相同，其中一种损害难以逆转。评审应如何处理？
questions.a: 将可逆性纳入相称控制和取舍记录
wrong: 收益相同所以控制必须相同
忽略损害只比较速度

en.q: Two uses have equal benefits, but harm from one is hard to reverse. What should the review do?
en.a: Include reversibility in proportionate controls and the trade-off record
wrong: Equal benefits require identical controls
Ignore harm and compare only speed

questions.quote: 讨论效率收益时同时说明受影响对象、损害可能性、严重程度和可逆性。选择与影响相称的控制，并记录取舍和决定责任。

rationale.zh: 把不允许用途与人工介入落实到验收门。
rationale.en: Make prohibited uses and human review concrete acceptance gates.

misconception.zh: 先做功能，验收时只测速度。
misconception.en: Build features first and test only speed at acceptance.

title.zh: 从用途定义开始设置保障：决策演练
title.en: Safeguards from use-case definition: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练规定按用途定义→保障设计→验证迭代推进。将步骤排序。
prompt.en: Case workflow requires use definition, safeguard design, then iterative validation. Order the steps.

reason.zh: 先界定允许和不允许用途，再设置数据、功能和人工介入保障，最后以这些要求验证并迭代。 常见错误：先做功能，验收时只测速度。 回看《从用途定义开始设置保障》。
reason.en: Define permitted and prohibited uses, then design data, feature and human-intervention safeguards, and validate against those requirements. Common error: Build features first and test only speed at acceptance. Review “Safeguards from use-case definition”.

text.zh: 设计资料、功能及人工介入保障
text.en: Design data, feature and human-review safeguards

text.zh: 纳入验收并迭代验证
text.en: Include safeguards in acceptance and iterate tests

text.zh: 定义用途与禁止场景
text.en: Define intended and prohibited uses

questions.q: 设计验收标准时发现高影响操作需要人工介入，应该如何处理？
questions.a: 把介入情形和保障纳入设计及验证
wrong: 只测响应速度
等上线后用户投诉才定义介入

en.q: During acceptance design, a high-impact action needs human intervention. What should happen?
en.a: Include intervention conditions and safeguards in design and validation
wrong: Test only response speed
Define intervention only after complaints

questions.quote: 在选择数据、设计功能和定义验收标准时纳入责任要求，识别不允许的用途和需要人工介入的情形，再迭代验证。

rationale.zh: 检查监督是否具有实际介入能力。
rationale.en: Check whether oversight has practical intervention capacity.

misconception.zh: 安排一个签字人即可构成有效监督。
misconception.en: Assigning a signer creates effective oversight.

title.zh: 复核能力与升级阈值：决策演练
title.en: Review capability and escalation triggers: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练：复核员只能看到结论，必须立即签字且无暂停权。选择所有必要补强。
prompt.en: Case: a reviewer sees only conclusions, must sign immediately, and cannot pause actions. Select all necessary improvements.

reason.zh: 监督需要证据、时间、训练、停止或修改权，并给无来源结论等触发事件指定接手人；单纯签字不提供能力。 常见错误：安排一个签字人即可构成有效监督。 回看《复核能力与升级阈值》。
reason.en: Oversight needs evidence, time, training, stop or modification authority, and owners for triggers such as unsupported conclusions. A signature alone provides no capability. Common error: Assigning a signer creates effective oversight. Review “Review capability and escalation triggers”.

text.zh: 只增加签字次数
text.en: Only require more signatures

text.zh: 提供证据、复核时间和训练
text.en: Provide evidence, review time and training

text.zh: 定义无来源结论等升级条件与接手者
text.en: Define unsupported-claim escalation and takeover owners

text.zh: 授予停止或修改权限
text.en: Grant stop or modification authority

questions.q: 出现无来源的重要结论，复核员没有停止权。最直接的治理缺口是什么？
questions.a: 监督缺少实际权限与明确升级接手
wrong: 复核员签名不够漂亮

prompt.en: Case authority: analyst performs validation; business lead owns the final deployment decision. Select only those two assignments.

prompt.zh: 将调查线索放到最直接的阶段；分类只定位线索，不代表已证明因果。
prompt.en: Route each investigation clue to its direct stage. Classification locates a clue; it does not establish causality.

reason.zh: 遗漏群体指向采样、同例异标指向标注、新人群差异指向部署环境；仍需持续分组检查和原因调查。 常见错误：训练前检查一次就能排除部署后的偏差。 回看《生命周期中的偏差》。
reason.en: Missing groups point to sampling, inconsistent labels to labeling, and a new population to deployment context. Ongoing subgroup assessment and investigation are still needed. Common error: One pretraining check excludes deployment bias forever. Review “Bias across the lifecycle”.

text.zh: 采样
text.en: Sampling

text.zh: 标注
text.en: Labeling

text.zh: 部署环境
text.en: Deployment context

text.zh: 样本没有覆盖一个受影响群体
text.en: A relevant group is absent from samples

text.zh: 相同案例被不同人员标成相反结果
text.en: The same case receives conflicting labels

text.zh: 上线人群与评估人群发生变化
text.en: Deployed population differs from evaluation population

questions.q: 上线后新增人群表现变差，训练前检查曾通过。应该怎么做？
questions.a: 持续检查分组表现并调查环境变化
wrong: 认定过去通过所以现在无偏差
只保留总体平均

en.q: A new deployment group performs poorly despite a passed earlier check. What next?
en.a: Check subgroup outcomes over time and investigate changed conditions
wrong: Assume earlier success rules out current bias
Keep only the overall average

questions.quote: 偏差可能来自采样、标注、训练目标和部署环境等阶段。持续观察分组表现及环境变化，不把一次检查当作永久结论。

rationale.zh: 并列检查内容安全、来源授权和输出用途。
rationale.en: Check content safety, source permissions and output use separately.

misconception.zh: 模型生成天然无害且没有权利限制。
misconception.en: Model-generated content is inherently harmless and unrestricted.

title.zh: 有害内容与知识产权：决策演练
title.en: Harmful content and intellectual property: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练团队准备发布生成材料。选择所有发布前应核对的方面。
prompt.en: The case team plans to publish generated material. Select all aspects needing review before release.

reason.zh: 生成方式不证明内容无害或资料有授权；需按用途设置审核和处置，而不是让模型自行保证。 常见错误：模型生成天然无害且没有权利限制。 回看《有害内容与知识产权》。
reason.en: Generation does not prove harmlessness or source permission. Review and remediation must fit the use rather than relying on a model guarantee. Common error: Model-generated content is inherently harmless and unrestricted. Review “Harmful content and intellectual property”.

text.zh: 输入资料使用授权
text.en: Permission to use input materials

text.zh: 输出用途与有害内容风险
text.en: Output use and harmful-content risks

text.zh: 仅确认内容是模型生成
text.en: Only confirm the content was model-generated

text.zh: 审核与处置流程
text.en: Review and remediation procedures

questions.q: 材料由模型生成，团队因此省略授权和内容审核。判断如何？
questions.a: 生成不免除这些检查
wrong: 模型生成必然无害
模型生成必然无权利限制

en.q: A team skips rights and content reviews because a model generated the material. What is correct?
en.a: Generation does not remove these checks
wrong: Generated content is always harmless
Generated content always has unrestricted rights

questions.quote: 检查内容风险、资料使用授权和输出用途，设置适当审核与处置流程。不假定模型生成就天然无害或无权利限制。

rationale.zh: 把流畅表达与证据支持分离并选择复核动作。
rationale.en: Separate fluent wording from evidence and choose verification actions.

misconception.zh: 内容听起来可信就说明可靠。
misconception.en: Plausible language establishes reliability.

title.zh: 幻觉与可靠性：决策演练

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练：一段流畅答案没有支持来源，拟用于重要决定。选择全部合理动作。
prompt.en: Case: a fluent answer has no supporting sources and may inform an important decision. Select all appropriate actions.

reason.zh: 可信措辞不能补上缺失证据；来源核验、数据检查与必要人工复核共同管理可靠性，未知应保留。 常见错误：内容听起来可信就说明可靠。 回看《幻觉与可靠性》。
reason.en: Plausibility cannot supply missing evidence. Source verification, data checks and appropriate human review manage reliability while preserving unknowns. Common error: Plausible language establishes reliability. Review “Hallucination and reliability”.

text.zh: 因措辞流畅直接执行
text.en: Act immediately because it reads fluently

text.zh: 核对来源支持与数据质量
text.en: Verify source support and data quality

text.zh: 必要时交人工复核并保留未知
text.en: Seek human review when needed and retain uncertainty

questions.q: 一段答案很具体且自信，但没有依据。能否直接当可靠事实？
questions.a: 不能，应核验支持并必要时人工复核
wrong: 可以，细节越多越可靠
可以，自信就是依据

en.q: An answer is detailed and confident but unsupported. Can it be treated as reliable fact?
en.a: No; verify support and seek human review as needed
wrong: Yes; detail guarantees reliability
Yes; confidence is evidence

questions.quote: 幻觉可能表现为看似可信但无依据的内容。结合来源核验、数据质量检查、监测和必要人工复核来管理风险。

rationale.zh: 让事件响应先限制影响，再调查验证恢复。
rationale.en: Practice containing impact before investigation and verified restoration.

misconception.zh: 发现异常后先扩大上线才能获得更多样本。
misconception.en: Expand deployment first to gather more incident samples.

title.zh: 检测、限制、调查与恢复：决策演练
title.en: Detection, containment, investigation and recovery: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练已检测到异常并保全日志；规定先限制影响，再调查修复，验证满足恢复条件后才扩大。排列后续行动。
prompt.en: An anomaly is detected and logs are preserved. Case policy requires containment, investigation and repair, then validation before wider restoration. Order the actions.

reason.zh: 先控制受影响范围避免损害继续，再用版本、输入输出和告警追踪原因；修复须验证，不能以修复声明替代恢复条件。 常见错误：发现异常后先扩大上线才能获得更多样本。 回看《检测、限制、调查与恢复》。
reason.en: Containment limits further harm; versions, inputs, outputs and alerts support investigation. Validate remediation rather than treating a repair claim as a restoration condition. Common error: Expand deployment first to gather more incident samples. Review “Detection, containment, investigation and recovery”.

text.zh: 利用版本与事件日志调查并修复
text.en: Investigate and repair using version and event logs

text.zh: 验证恢复条件再扩大使用
text.en: Validate restoration conditions before expanding use

text.zh: 暂停或限制受影响流程
text.en: Pause or contain the affected process

questions.q: 修复已提交，但尚未验证恢复条件。下一步是什么？
questions.a: 先验证修复与恢复条件
wrong: 立即扩大所有使用
删除旧版本日志

en.q: A repair is submitted but restoration conditions remain unvalidated. What next?
en.a: Validate remediation and restoration conditions first
wrong: Immediately expand to all users
Delete old-version logs

questions.quote: 记录模型版本、输入、输出和告警以便追踪；出现异常时先控制影响，再调查、修复和验证，满足恢复条件后再扩大使用。

rationale.zh: 为差异准备多阶段调查假设，避免一因解释。
rationale.en: Prepare multi-stage hypotheses for disparities instead of assuming a single cause.

misconception.zh: 分组差异一定只来自训练样本。
misconception.en: Subgroup disparities can only come from training samples.

title.zh: 采样、标注、目标与部署：决策演练
title.en: Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练发现群体差异。选择所有值得调查的可能来源；本题不把任何线索直接判为根因。
prompt.en: A case reveals subgroup disparities. Select every plausible source to investigate; none is declared the root cause here.

reason.zh: 代表性、标注一致性、优化目标和部署人群都可能影响差异，应结合持续监测调查，而不是先锁定一个根因。 常见错误：分组差异一定只来自训练样本。 回看《采样、标注、目标与部署》。
reason.en: Representation, labeling consistency, optimization objectives and deployment populations can affect disparities. Investigate with ongoing monitoring rather than assuming one root cause. Common error: Subgroup disparities can only come from training samples. Review “Sampling, labels, objectives and deployment”.

text.zh: 优化目标与部署人群变化
text.en: Optimization objectives and deployment-population changes

text.zh: 样本代表性与标注一致性
text.en: Sample representation and label consistency

text.zh: 因总体平均稳定而停止调查
text.en: Stop investigating because the overall average is stable

questions.q: 群体差异出现，但样本代表性检查正常。能否结束偏差调查？
questions.a: 不能，还需调查标注、目标和部署等来源
wrong: 能，样本是唯一来源
能，只要总体平均没变

en.q: A subgroup disparity appears despite normal sample-representation checks. Can the bias investigation end?
en.a: No; investigate labeling, objectives and deployment too
wrong: Yes; samples are the only source
Yes if the overall average is unchanged

questions.quote: 偏差可能源自缺乏代表性的样本、不一致标注、优化目标和部署人群差异。对相关群体持续监测，并调查差异的原因。

rationale.zh: 让来源许可和输出安全分别占一个检查门。
rationale.en: Give source permission and output safety independent review gates.

misconception.zh: 资料有授权就证明生成内容安全。
misconception.en: Licensed inputs prove generated outputs are safe.

title.zh: 来源授权、输出用途与有害内容：决策演练
title.en: Source rights, output uses and harmful content: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练报告只记录“来源有授权，输出未审”。选择所有仍需处理的工作。
prompt.en: The case report says sources are authorized but outputs are unreviewed. Select all remaining work.

reason.zh: 来源授权只回答允许如何使用资料；输出用途、内容风险、投诉与处置仍需核对。反过来，过滤有害内容也不证明获得许可。 常见错误：资料有授权就证明生成内容安全。 回看《来源授权、输出用途与有害内容》。
reason.en: Source permission addresses allowed source use. Output use, content risk, complaints and remediation still need review. Conversely, harmful-content filtering does not prove permission. Common error: Licensed inputs prove generated outputs are safe. Review “Source rights, output uses and harmful content”.

text.zh: 按输出用途进行内容审核
text.en: Review content for intended output use

text.zh: 直接把来源授权当成输出安全证明
text.en: Treat source authorization as proof of output safety

text.zh: 设置投诉与处置流程
text.en: Establish complaints and remediation procedures

questions.q: 输出通过有害内容过滤，却未核对来源许可。可否认定已获版权许可？
questions.a: 不能，内容安全与来源许可是不同检查
wrong: 可以，过滤即代表许可
可以，未发现有害词就足够

en.q: An output passes harmful-content filtering, but source permission is unchecked. Does that prove copyright permission?
en.a: No; content safety and source permission are separate checks
wrong: Yes; filtering implies permission
Yes; no harmful terms is enough

questions.quote: 核对输入资料允许的使用方式，并根据输出用途设置内容审核、投诉和处置流程。来源有授权不等于输出一定安全，过滤有害内容也不能证明已获版权许可。

rationale.zh: 按显式演练状态编码修复证据卡，保留未知。
rationale.en: Repair an evidence card using explicit case status codes while retaining unknowns.

misconception.zh: 看到相关引用就默认支持结论且版本正确。
misconception.en: A related citation automatically supports the claim and has the right version.

title.zh: 证据支持与不确定性：决策演练
title.en: Evidence support and uncertainty: decision lab

brief.zh: 先阅读本单元，再按题面给定条件操作；角色、数值及流程约束仅用于教材演练，不构成外部法律判断。
brief.en: Read this unit first, then apply the stated case conditions. Roles, values and workflow constraints are exercise assumptions, not external legal determinations.

prompt.zh: 演练编码：已核验=1，未知=0。资料主题相关已核验；引用是否支持具体结论未知；版本是否最新未知。修复三格为对应数值。
prompt.en: Exercise codes: verified=1, unknown=0. Topic relevance is verified; support for the specific claim is unknown; current source version is unknown. Repair the three cells.

reason.zh: 相关性不等于具体支持，版本也要单独检查；因此为1、0、0。不能将未知填成已证实，重要未知需升级复核。 常见错误：看到相关引用就默认支持结论且版本正确。 回看《证据支持与不确定性》。
reason.en: Relevance is not claim support, and version needs a separate check, so values are 1, 0, 0. Do not promote unknowns to verified facts; escalate important unknowns. Common error: A related citation automatically supports the claim and has the right version. Review “Evidence support and uncertainty”.

questions.q: 引用主题相关，但是否支持重要结论及版本均未知。应如何表达？
questions.a: 保留不确定性并升级复核支持与版本
wrong: 直接宣布结论已经证实
删除未知标记保持答案流畅

en.q: A citation is topically relevant, but support for an important claim and its version are unknown. What should be communicated?
en.a: Retain uncertainty and escalate support and version checks
wrong: Declare the claim verified
Remove unknown markers for fluent wording

questions.quote: 幻觉是看似可信却错误或无依据的内容。核对资料相关性、引用支持和版本，对重要未知保留不确定性并升级复核。

rationale.zh: 在业务情境中判断下一步，而非复述定义。
rationale.en: Judge the next action in context rather than recite a definition.

misconception.zh: 只核对模型采购发票
misconception.en: Check only the model invoice

brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练已购买模型，负责人据此宣布准备就绪。选出下一步。
prompt.en: The exercise team bought a model and declares readiness. Select the next action.

reason.zh: 采购不能证明组织能持续使用，必须检查多个条件；回看“组织准备度”。
reason.en: A purchase does not establish the conditions for sustainable use. Revisit Organizational readiness.

text.zh: 只核对模型采购发票
text.en: Check only the model invoice

text.zh: 检查领导、数据、文化、基础设施与治理的准备证据
text.en: Check readiness evidence for leadership, data, culture, infrastructure and governance

questions.q: 部门只有模型采购记录，如何判断能否开始业务采用？
questions.a: 检查领导、数据、文化、基础设施与治理的准备证据
wrong: 只核对模型采购发票

en.q: A department has only a model purchase record. How should adoption readiness be assessed?
en.a: Check readiness evidence for leadership, data, culture, infrastructure and governance
wrong: Check only the model invoice

questions.quote: 评估领导共识、数据、文化、基础设施与治理等维度；不能只检查是否买到了模型。

rationale.zh: 在业务情境中判断下一步，而非复述定义。
rationale.en: Judge the next action in context rather than recite a definition.

misconception.zh: 把一次试点成功记为可持续规模运营
misconception.en: Count one successful pilot as sustainable scaled operation

title.zh: AI成熟度

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练试点运行一次，团队想只报告高分。如何使用成熟度评估？
prompt.en: The exercise pilot ran once; the team wants only a high score. How should maturity be used?

reason.zh: 成熟度帮助定位发展方向，一次表现不能替代稳定能力；回看“AI成熟度”。
reason.en: Maturity locates development needs; one result does not establish stable capability. Revisit AI maturity.

text.zh: 识别到可重复持续运营还缺什么能力
text.en: Identify capabilities still missing for repeatable sustainable operation

text.zh: 把一次试点成功记为可持续规模运营
text.en: Count one successful pilot as sustainable scaled operation

questions.q: 试点成功后，成熟度评估最应回答什么？
questions.a: 识别到可重复持续运营还缺什么能力
wrong: 把一次试点成功记为可持续规模运营

en.q: After pilot success, what should a maturity assessment establish?
en.a: Identify capabilities still missing for repeatable sustainable operation
wrong: Count one successful pilot as sustainable scaled operation

questions.quote: 成熟度描述从探索、实验到可持续运营等能力状态。它用于识别下一步发展方向，不只是给组织打一个漂亮分数。

rationale.zh: 诊断不同职责或条件，避免一个措施解决所有问题。
rationale.en: Diagnose distinct responsibilities or conditions rather than apply one remedy to everything.

misconception.zh: 只需再买一套模型
misconception.en: Only another model purchase is needed

title.zh: 能力差距

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练把两项阻碍分到实际缺口。
prompt.en: Classify the actual gaps in these exercise blockers.

reason.zh: 不会操作需要技能支持；缺授权不能靠更多工具培训解决；回看“能力差距”。
reason.en: A skill gap needs learning support; absent authorization is not repaired by tool training. Revisit Capability gaps.

text.zh: 人员技能
text.en: Skills

text.zh: 权限
text.en: Authority

text.zh: 员工获授权但不会核验回答
text.en: An authorized worker cannot verify answers

text.zh: 员工会操作但没有资料访问授权
text.en: A skilled worker lacks data access authorization

questions.q: 员工会操作却无访问授权，应先诊断什么？
questions.a: 权限缺口
wrong: 只需再买一套模型

en.q: A skilled worker lacks access authorization. What gap should be diagnosed first?
en.a: An authority gap
wrong: Only another model purchase is needed

questions.quote: 从人员、流程、技术和治理找出具体缺口，区分缺少技能、缺少权限和缺少合适流程等问题。

rationale.zh: 重建给定依赖链，证明知道为何不能跳步。
rationale.en: Reconstruct a dependency chain and explain why steps cannot be skipped.

misconception.zh: 先采购再寻找适用目标
misconception.en: Purchase first and find goals later

title.zh: 发展路线与投入顺序

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练按依赖安排路线：目标尚不清、准备度未评估、投入未批准。
prompt.en: Order this exercise roadmap with unclear goals, unassessed readiness and unapproved investment.

reason.zh: 先知道要达成什么和当前条件，再安排验证性投入，不能从采购倒推目标；回看“发展路线与投入顺序”。
